user.title: Tisséo
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.stop_search: A stop (search by name or ID)
menu_options.nearby: A stop near my home (top 10 by distance)

stop_search.title: Tisséo stop
stop_search.description: Search a stop by name (e.g. Capitole, Jeanne d'Arc) or enter a GTFS stop id (stop_area:SA_1715 / stop_point:SP_1912). The first setup downloads and indexes the Tisséo GTFS (≈14 MB, up to a minute).

stop.title: Choose the stop
stop.description: A stop area covers every platform/direction; a platform is a single stop point (usually one direction).

settings.title: Departures at {stop}
settings.description: Leave the line list empty to include every line serving the stop. The Tisséo API key is optional: request one from opendata@tisseo.fr; without it the integration uses the keyless open data.

data.realtime: Use live predictions when published (buses, tram)

journey.title: Journey
journey.description: Search the origin and destination stops.

journey_pick.title: Journey
journey_pick.description: Direct trips and connections with up to two transfers are searched in the timetable (and adjusted with live data when available).

bike.title: VélôToulouse station
bike.description: Stations closest to your home location.

park_ride.title: Park-and-ride
park_ride.description: Only the capacity is published as open data; live occupancy is not available without the Tisséo website.

reauth_confirm.title: Tisséo API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Tisséo API rejected the key configured for {title}. Enter a new key, or leave the field empty to use the keyless open data only.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download the Tisséo GTFS feed.
error.no_stop: No stop matches this name or ID.
error.invalid_key: The Tisséo API rejected this key.
error.api_unreachable: The Tisséo API could not be reached to check the key; try again or leave it empty.
error.same_stop: Origin and destination are the same stop.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not download the Tisséo GTFS feed.
abort.no_nearby: No Tisséo stop within 5 km of the home location.
abort.cannot_connect_gbfs: Could not reach the VélôToulouse GBFS feed.
abort.cannot_connect_parkride: Could not reach the Toulouse Métropole open data portal.

init.title: Tisséo options
init.description: API key configured: {api}. Leave the key field empty to keep the current key.

data.realtime: Use live predictions when published (buses, tram)

error.invalid_key: The Tisséo API rejected this key.
error.api_unreachable: The Tisséo API could not be reached to check the key; try again or leave it empty.

invalid_api_key.title: Tisséo API key rejected ({title})
invalid_api_key.description: The official Tisséo API rejected the configured key, so {title} fell back to the keyless open data. Open Settings → Devices & services → Tisséo and follow the re-authentication prompt to enter a new key or remove it.

get_trip.name: Get trip stops
get_trip.description: Returns the calls (stops and times) of one trip from the timetable index, adjusted with live data when available.

trip_id.name: Trip ID
trip_id.description: GTFS trip id (attribute trip_id of a departure).

stop_id.name: Stop ID
stop_id.description: Optional stop where the trip was seen (pins the service day).

scheduled.name: Scheduled time
scheduled.description: Optional scheduled departure (ISO 8601) at that stop.
